themes.title: Single-agent KRAS G12C inhibition produces sub-50% ORR in pretreated NSCLC
themes.paragraph: Both sotorasib [T2] and adagrasib [T2] showed objective response rates between 37-43% in pretreated NSCLC patients with KRAS G12C mutations, establishing single-agent efficacy but with a ceiling that motivates combination strategies.

gaps.description: No head-to-head randomized comparison between sotorasib and adagrasib has been reported.
